summary:
I checked about 140 factual claims in the draft against the read-only clone at 438c8d65, the evidence folder and the local ledger, using my own commands. I found 3 ERRORE and 11 IMPRECISIONE; nothing else was wrong.

ERRORE:
1. The SHA 6081832... in R-2 and in the GPT prompt is the sha256 of plan.json, not of preflight_plan.json, whose sha256 is ea2cef0f....
2. "Diagnostica non ancora lanciata" (Esito table) and "non ancora deployata ne' lanciata" (prompt) are now out of date. After the draft was saved (11:23:41), the common ledger records GPT's submissions at 11:32: checkout 64835236, cuda 64835286, resume-CN 64835297, resume-CR 64835304. The 10:07 reading was correct at the time. I did not check Leonardo itself (no ssh).

IMPRECISIONE:
- On the real reader path, the historical calibration 64701482 is stopped by the recipe check (contrastive_prepare.py:273-274), not by the source guard. This affects point 2 and M-1.
- The two P2-M1 skeptics confirmed only the two audit barriers; a third skeptic (P2-N1) confirmed the receipt guard.
- 64652559 ran 187 s over its limit, more than the 180 s OverTimeLimit.
- 0d91297 touches 30 files, not 26; at the tip run.py also carries the contrastive code.
- The registry at the tip drops one duplicate heading and adds 23 lines, so not every line is kept.
- N-3 is not one of the critic's gaps; it is reviewer finding P6-N3, already confirmed by one skeptic.
- The "cumulato della linea 3" covers only the CONTRASTIVE-v2-20261116 campaign, not the log-quadratic part of line 3.
- C0−T100-G appears in more places than the limitations; the protocol's par. 6 still calls it a compatibility control.
- The `scope` field of the plan was rewritten, not added.
- 438c8d65 also adds the prompt and registry entries and updates local_validation.json.
- N-2 is missing from rows 1 and 2 of the Esito table.
